descriptions.w3d_f2a_initialize_orientation_8002d2c8: Clears offset 76, sums two original float-property queries into the vector at offset 88, and initializes scalar fields from 0x80372964. For a nonnegative resolved index, copies x/z from the resolved object and derives two scalar fields from 0x80372968 minus its offset-72 value. Copies and flattens the position vector, computes cosine/sine direction, and copies it to offset 28. Names are inferred; external data ownership is not claimed.
